threads.body: I didn't see any reason this test needed to use the (now deprecated) Jaeger propagator

this bug was hidden by 2 other bugs:

1. A (long-time) existing SDK bug that empty strings are serialized as "empty value" attributes (this may be fixed in the future by https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java/pull/8014).
2. A bug in this repo's testing framework which used to skip "empty value" attributes when deserializing (which is fixed in this PR, see the new `case VALUE_NOT_SET:` in `TelemetryConverter.java`.
can't you use the constants from `ValueType` here instead of names?
I'd guess that `duplicate` isn't probably necessary
`testing.runWithSpan("test-span", () -> Span.current().setAttribute(valueKey("key"), Value.of(123L)))` would be slightly more compact, but it is fine this way too
